The only validated edge is drawdown control via the absolute-trend gate, so this note leans low overall; the directional hit rate on this analyst's 108-call record is 44%, so conviction is deliberately restrained.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the Non-AI Software headline (IGV) is a durable leader or a late-cycle consolidation: the one condition that would retire this watch is IGV giving up its absolute-trend eligibility while Cybersecurity (CIBR) holds its own trend and breadth above 0.70 — i.e., a confirmed internal software handoff rather than a fresh leader.

theses.subject: Non-AI Software
theses.thesis: Non-AI Software is the only theme combining a durable absolute uptrend (hurst_tag trend, durability_bar 0.74) with genuine breadth (0.857) — the two legs that matter most here. It is the headline narrative and rank-2 but also crowded (z=1.45); per guardrails, crowding is a cap/size-down caution, not a fade. A modest trend-following lean is justified only so long as the trend gate keeps it eligible (risk control), with size owned by the allocator.
evidence: eligible=true (absolute-trend gate passes — the one validated risk-control leg)
theses.dissent: Crowding z=1.45 flags a mature, well-owned narrative; reflexivity means the consensus trade can unwind violently on any software earnings miss, and rank-IC ~0 means the focus itself carries no predictive edge — this is a risk-controlled lean, not a fundamental call.

falsifier.text: IGV lags SPY by 5% before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity shows a persistent trend (hurst_tag trend, durability_bar 0.76, eligible) with solid breadth 0.70. It is crowded (z=1.58) which argues for restraint rather than avoidance, but the trend-gate eligibility plus durability are the defensible legs for a modest positive lean as a complement to the software complex.
theses.dissent: Very crowded (z=1.58) and rank-3 after two crowded software names — this could be one undifferentiated trade in the same 'quality software' umbrella; if the software complex corrects, cybersecurity is highly correlated and offers little diversification.

falsifier.text: CIBR gives up its 60-day trend and closes below its 50-day moving average before the check-by date

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma has the strongest durability reading outside the software complex (durability_bar 0.80, hurst_tag trend) with exceptional breadth 0.889 and trend-gate eligibility. It is crowded (z=1.25) but the combination of trend health and breadth is among the cleanest in the table, and defensiveness may suit a market with unscheduled surprise share at 1.0.
theses.dissent: Crowded z=1.25 and a rate-sensitive sector — if the inflation/energy macro narrative (top-4 headline) pushes yields higher, defensives like pharma can lag cyclicals; the trend gate offers drawdown help, not upside.

falsifier.text: PPH lags SPY by 5% before the 30-day check-by date
